assertion10.statement: Every nonordinary absolutely irreducible Pi with nonzero irreducible Pi_alg satisfies BM RED relative to the exact Dospinescu imports.
assertion10.objects: Actual admissible unitary fixed-central-character E-Banach Pi; span R(Pi) of self-extensions exact on algebraic vectors.
assertion10.hypotheses: Pi is a nonordinary Banach representation in the source category; Pi_alg nonzero and irreducible; exact source Theorem1.3 and Propositions1.4-1.5.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every such Pi and every generating extension; no restriction on target residual semisimplification.
assertion10.parameter_range: p=5, finite E/Q5, length-two extensions in the same fixed central character category.
assertion10.uniformity: The proof covers nonordinary principal, special and supercuspidal smooth factors without identifying that factor.
assertion10.constants: Dimension R(Pi)<=1; no equality assertion for R(Pi).
assertion10.normalizations: Fixed determinant epsilon*zeta is imposed over E[t]/t^2, not on the underlying four-dimensional E-representation.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: Ordinary Banach representations and reducible Pi_alg are outside this lemma; special Galois case is excluded by Proposition1.5.
assertion10.limit_order: First close algebraic vectors in each exact extension; pass to quotient by closed Pi; then include linear spans in Ext_alg.

assertion10.statement: A RED representation with multiplicity-one K-type has type multiplicity at most2 in the specified first-order extension.
assertion10.objects: Exact Banach sequence0->Pi->X->Pi^m->0, locally algebraic K-type V, pullback alpha on YonedaExt and injective connecting map delta.
assertion10.hypotheses: Pi_alg irreducible; End_G(Pi)=E; RED; dimHom_K(V,Pi)=1; dimHom_G(Pi,X)=1.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every finite m>=0 and every such sequence; if Hom_K(V,Pi)=0 the output dimension is0.
assertion10.parameter_range: G=GL2(Q5),K=GL2(Z5), finite coefficient extension; fixed central character.
assertion10.uniformity: The argument is independent of ordinary/nonordinary classification once RED and multiplicity are supplied.
assertion10.normalizations: alpha is pullback along a chosen nonzero j:V->Pi; delta is the Yoneda connecting map from Hom_G(Pi,Pi^m).
assertion10.exceptional_cases: No bound is claimed without Hom_G dimension1 or without the separate multiplicity-one input.
assertion10.limit_order: Lift the K-type for a kernel class, generate its G-span in X_alg, prove exactness there, then apply the Hom exact sequences.
